title: crataegus pseudoheterophylla subsp. turkestanica
intro: Crataegus pseudoheterophylla subsp. turkestanica, commonly known as the Turkestan hawthorn, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in medicine to aid in various health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, improving heart health, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus pseudoheterophylla subsp. turkestanica include cardiotonic, diuretic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its potential as a natural remedy for cardiovascular conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
